claim: Supabase free-tier projects auto-pause after 7 days of database inactivity, and dashboard visits do not count as activity — only real DB queries reset the timer.
quote: The 7-day inactivity window is tracked against your database activity, not API requests or UI visits. That means even if you're regularly checking the Supabase dashboard, if no actual queries are hitting the database, the timer keeps ticking.

claim: When a Supabase free project is paused the data and schema are preserved, but reactivation takes ~30 seconds and the project must be manually restored.
quote: When a pause happens, your compute instance is essentially shut down. The database itself isn't deleted, your schema, data, and backup history are preserved but the project takes around 30 seconds to wake up when it receives its next request.

claim: Real users on GitHub report Supabase projects stuck in paused state with the unpause button failing for over an hour, sometimes tied to regional outages.
quote: ap-south-1 can't create or restore new projects right now

claim: Free-tier Supabase users have reported projects stuck in a 'Pausing…' state indefinitely with no successful resolution even after upgrading to Pro for priority support.
Vercel officially states SQLite cannot be used with their platform because serverless storage is ephemeral and each function instance gets its own filesystem.
quote: SQLite can't be used with Vercel

claim: Replit migrated its built-in database off Neon to its own managed Postgres on December 4, 2025, and ships every Replit App with 20GB free storage plus checkpoint-based rollback.
quote: Prior to December 4th, 2025, the development database was hosted on Neon

claim: Writes to a deployed Repl's local filesystem (including local SQLite files) do not persist across redeploys, so vibe-coded apps that default to file storage silently lose user data.
quote: Writes to the local filesystem will not persist to the Repl - the data will disappear on any following re-deploys.

claim: Lovable Cloud bundles database, auth, storage and AI auto-provisioned per workspace with $25 monthly cloud credit and $1 AI credit, and free-plan projects pause automatically when credits run out.
quote: $25 Cloud balance ... $1 AI balance ... your projects pause automatically

claim: Bolt Cloud bundles managed databases, native auth (signups, logins, password resets, RBAC), file storage and hosting into one no-config product targeted at non-technical builders.
quote: Signups, logins, password resets, and role based access

claim: Lovable apps routinely embed third-party API keys (Stripe, OpenAI, SendGrid, analytics) directly into the JavaScript bundle where credential-harvesters find them within hours.
quote: Lovable apps frequently embed API keys for third-party services (Stripe, OpenAI, SendGrid, analytics) directly into the JavaScript bundle

claim: In March 2026, 1.5 million API keys were leaked from a single vibe-coded app shipped without security review, and OWASP added a dedicated 2025 Top-10 category for vibe-coding risk patterns.
quote: In March 2026, 1.5 million API keys were leaked when a founder shipped a vibe coded app without a single security review

claim: On April 4, 2026 Anthropic banned subscription OAuth tokens in third-party tools, instantly breaking apps with embedded Claude credentials and forcing migration to pay-as-you-go API keys.
quote: As of April 4, 2026, Anthropic prohibited the use of subscription OAuth tokens in third-party tools

claim: Clerk's free tier in 2026 covers 50,000 Monthly Active Users with unlimited social logins and organizations, raised from a prior 10,000 MAU cap.
Clerk ships separate development and production instance keys, and a common deployment failure is forgetting to swap dev keys for prod keys when going live.
quote: A common mistake when deploying to production is forgetting to change your API keys to your production instances keys.

claim: Google OAuth refresh tokens expire after just 7 days while the consent screen is in Testing mode, and after ~6 months of non-use once published — a silent failure mode for workshop apps.
quote: is issued a refresh token expiring in 7 days

claim: Vercel Hobby is free but personal-use only, and when monthly limits are hit the deployment is paused with no warning page until the next billing cycle resets.
quote: Hobby has no overage option. When you hit the limit, your deployment pauses until the next billing cycle resets. No throttling, no warning page. The app goes offline.
